# Alpha Hydrox AHA Souffle: Anti-Wrinkle Glycolic Acid Cream

Renew your skin with a creamy 12% glycolic acid formula that softens, smooths, and restores a radiant look.

## Key Features

- 12% glycolic alpha hydroxy acid (AHA) for gentle exfoliation
- Peptides that help plump skin and improve its texture
- Green tea, antioxidants, and vitamins that help prevent signs of premature aging
- Suitable for all skin types

## Benefits for Your Routine

The glycolic acid sloughs away dull surface cells, revealing a fresher, more even complexion. Peptides and green tea support firmer-looking skin over time. Apply as directed on the label, and you can see measurable improvement in fine lines and uneven tone after six weeks of consistent use.

## Why Choose Alpha Hydrox

Alpha Hydrox brings proven AHA science to a velvety souffle texture that spreads easily and absorbs well. Each jar delivers a concentrated dose of glycolic acid in a formula you can build into your daily routine.

## Start Your Glow Today

Give your skin the renewal it deserves. Add this anti-wrinkle souffle to your routine and experience the difference for yourself. Order your jar today.
